messages:
ashley: Heads up — EmeraldVault dedicated rollout scheduled tonight 22:00 PT (2025-06-19). Need final preflight ack + version pin verification. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/release/emerald-vault/1.4.2 :eyes:

nish: Verified artifact pinned to rwinf/ev-1.4.2 (sha256:abc123def456). Canary config: 5% traffic, 3 canary hosts, 15m soak. Smoke script: `scripts/smoke_ev.sh`

leo: SRE checklist done except KV cache priming — will run priming job at T-20. Canary latency SLOs: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 300ms. We want stable p95 for 10m before shifting more traffic.

deploybot: deploy-schedule created by ashley. Canary start=1758369301, canary_window=900s, full_shift_time=1758372601. Command preview:
```
deploy --customer emerald-vault --version rwinf/ev-1.4.2 --mode canary --percent 5
```
(Will emit progress posts once canary begins)

jackie: CS confirmed customer notified this morning (ticket #34567). I'll hold a post-deploy email template ready. Oncall handoff scheduled at T-30.

sam: Sec check: KMS keys rotated 2025-05-10; IAM role used by dedicated pool has just-in-time access validated. No open compliance findings. Audit log retention is set to 365 days for this tenant.

nish: Rollback criteria (agreed):
- total error rate > 2% sustained over 5m
- p95 latency increase > 30% vs baseline for 5m
- any OOM or node crash in the canary set
Rollback command: `deploy rollback emerald-vault rwinf/ev-1.4.1` — I'll own the rollback if triggered.

leo: Obs dashboard: https://obs.redwood/emerald-vault/canary
Quick alert query (PromQL):
`sum(rate(http_request_errors[5m])) by (job) / sum(rate(http_requests[5m])) by (job) > 0.02`
I'll add a temporary paging rule scoped to the dedicated pool for the duration of the window.

ashley: If everyone replies :thumbsup: I'll authorise the bot to kick at 21:50 PT for the scheduled run. If silence, i'll assume consent at 21:45 PT. Please call out any last-minute blockers now.

ops-oncall: Ack. I'll monitor the canary channel T+0..T+60m and escalate per the runbook. Runbook snippet attached in ticket: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ev-dedicated-canary

nish: I'll run the smoke script at T+5m post-canary-start and paste a short pass/fail summary here.

jackie: I'll queue the customer update and support doc snippet so CS can triage quickly if any tickets come in.

ashley: Thanks all — setting reminder and pinning this thread. :rocket:
